home.faq_heading: Frequently asked questions about the KNM exam
home.faq_subheading: Everything you need to know before you start practicing
home.faq_a1: The KNM exam (Knowledge of Dutch Society) is part of the integration exam in the Netherlands. This exam tests whether you have sufficient knowledge of Dutch society, history, culture, rights and laws. It is mandatory for most people who want to integrate in the Netherlands.
home.faq_a1_link: Read more about how the KNM exam works →
home.faq_q2: How many questions does the KNM exam have?
home.faq_a2: The official KNM exam consists of 45 multiple-choice questions with three answer options (A, B or C). You must choose one correct answer per question. On this platform you practice with more than 450 validated questions divided over 10 practice exams, so you can practice thoroughly and efficiently.
home.faq_q3: How long does the KNM exam take?
home.faq_a3: You have 40 minutes to complete the KNM exam. On average it takes 25–30 minutes to fill in. It is a computer test that you take at an official DUO exam centre.
home.faq_q4: How do I prepare for the KNM exam?
home.faq_a4: The best preparation is to regularly practice with real exam questions, like on this platform. Practice a few minutes every day, learn from your mistakes, and focus on the topics where you still make errors.
home.faq_q5: What is a passing score for the KNM exam?
home.faq_a5: To pass you must answer at least 27 of the 45 questions correctly (60%). The higher you score, the more certain you can be that you will pass. On this platform you see your score per theme after completion, so you know exactly where you still need to practice.
home.faq_q6: How many times can I take the KNM exam?
home.faq_a6: In principle you may take the KNM exam multiple times. However, there are costs associated with each exam moment. The better your preparation, the greater the chance that you pass the first time.
